name: GCP — Disk Snapshot or Instance Creation (Potential Data Staging)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "snapshot" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "Snapshot" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type = "compute.disks.createSnapshot" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "compute.instances.insert"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as ops,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: compute.disks.createSnapshot, compute.snapshots.insert, or compute.instances.insert method — disk imaging or new compute resource potentially used to exfiltrate data.
alert_name: GCP — Disk Snapshot or Instance Creation (Potential Data Staging)
alert_description:
What fired: compute.disks.createSnapshot, compute.snapshots.insert, or compute.instances.insert method — disk imaging or new compute resource potentially used to exfiltrate data.

Why it matters: data may be leaving the environment through this channel. Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account (TA0010 - Exfiltration).

Investigate:
  - Quantify the volume and destination, and identify the user/host/principal moving the data.
  - Correlate with prior collection/staging and any defense-evasion steps; confirm the destination is not an approved service.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0010 - Exfiltration: T1537 - Transfer Data to Cloud Account
